description: This PHP script is designed to populate a recruitment database with sample data, including job titles, vacancies, candidates, and associated relations. It manages database connections, truncates existing tables, inserts new data, and handles related auxiliary functions.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prints or logs a value for debugging purposes (currently commented out).

methods.name: checkQueryResult
methods.description: Checks the result of a database query, outputs error if any, and rolls back the transaction if an error occurs.

methods.name: truncateTables
methods.description: Truncates (clears) specific tables related to candidates, vacancies, and job titles.

methods.name: addJobTitles
methods.description: Inserts predefined job titles into the database and updates the ID sequence.

methods.name: addJobVacancies
methods.description: Creates sample job vacancies with descriptions and updates the ID sequence.

methods.name: addCandidates
methods.description: Generates and inserts a specified number of candidate records, along with their associated data such as CVs, applications, and history entries.

methods.name: getCandidateQPartial
methods.description: Constructs a partial SQL insert statement for a candidate.

methods.name: getCvQPartial
methods.description: Constructs a partial SQL insert statement for a candidate's CV attachment.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancyQPartial
methods.description: Constructs a partial SQL insert for associating a candidate with a vacancy.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryQPartial
methods.description: Constructs a partial SQL insert for a candidate's history record.
